entities.name: Cuba as Staging Point and Treasure Fleet Hub
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Havana became the most important port in the Spanish Americas, serving as the assembly point for treasure fleets (flotas) returning to Spain laden with gold and silver from Mexico and Peru. The city was heavily fortified against pirate attacks.
